QuestInfo.name: A Message from Gen
QuestInfo.0: Someone is trying to reach you on the radio. You should answer it.
QuestInfo.1: Gen called on the radio. He wants you to go out and collect some debts on his behalf. Consult #b#p3001226##k on the desk.

0.msg: Huh? Is that the radio buzzing?\r\n

1.msg: Hey, rookie. Finished your missions from the Papyrus Brothers? I had to go for a meeting at Shadowdealer HQ. While I'm gone, there's something I want you to take care of.\r\n

2.msg: Unfortunately, some of our patrons are a little... ah, reluctant you might say, to settle their debts. I'd like you to pay them a visit and deliver a little bit of your specialized persuasion, if you know what I mean.\r\n

0.msg: So that's your next assignment. Collect debts from the people whose names are listed in my ledger. You'll find it on my desk. Gen out!\r\n

no.0: #b(Uh oh, you accidentally switched off the radio before the boss was finished.)#k\r\n

0.msg: #b(You check the ledger on the desk.)#k\r\n

1.msg: There are three debts in the ledger that haven't been crossed off. Gusto from the Black Market, Corbo at the #b#m402000100##k, and Antuin from the Pawn Shop in Brigand's Row...\r\n

2.msg: The last target's name seems to have been written with a bit more emphasis... What could that mean? Eh, it doesn't matter. You'll get to everyone on the list.\r\n #rYou will be moved to a new area if you accept.#k
